test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: On what sum of money will the difference between the simple interest and compound interest (Compounded annually) for 3 years at 5% per annum be Rs. 15.25?
solution:
**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) for 3 years at 5% per annum

Compound Interest (CI) for 3 years at 5% per annum

Difference between CI and SI for 3 years = ₹15.25

**Formula used:**

SI = P × R × T / 100

CI = P × (1 + R/100)T - P

Difference = CI - SI

**Calculation:**

Let the principal amount be P.

SI for 3 years = P × 5 × 3 / 100

SI = 15P / 100

SI = 0.15P

CI for 3 years = P × (1 + 5/100)³ - P

CI = P × 1.157625 - P

CI = 1.157625P - P

CI = 0.157625P

Difference = CI - SI

⇒ 0.157625P - 0.15P = 15.25

⇒ 0.007625P = 15.25

⇒ P = 15.25 / 0.007625

⇒ P = 2000

**∴ The sum of money is ₹2000.**

6d:T
